scope: development integration; no held-out MMLU quality or Jev speed claim

independent_numeric.reference_backend: CPU, n_gpu_layers=0, threads=6, F32 KV, flash attention disabled
independent_numeric.final_position: last prompt token; logits=true, no generated answer token
independent_numeric.formula: abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol * abs(reference) for every candidate
independent_numeric.near_tie: reference top-two margin <= twice maximum candidate allowance: selection verdict INCONCLUSIVE
independent_numeric.selection: first maximum; identity must match outside near-tie region
independent_numeric.reruns: no tolerance widening or best-repeat selection

performance.status: not measured; gate in issue 17 remains pending
performance.order: AB on even pair indices, BA on odd indices
performance.phase: synchronous scoring dispatch through copied result; direct engine candidate output copied equivalently
performance.estimator: ratio of paired means; two-sided 95% paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 14917
performance.resampling_unit: complete pair within one model/backend/mode combination
performance.gate: PASS upper<=1.02; FAIL lower>1.02; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
performance.exclusions: none; errors reported separately, required combination cannot pass with failures
performance.thermal_policy: single process/model, no simultaneous inference jobs; record host and power state
performance.decode_phase: not applicable; decisions perform no generation

quality.gemma: held-out, short generation baseline and all four cyclic MMLU rotations not run
quality.procedure: reuse existing paired 95% gains/losses conservative joint-coverage and 2pp non-inferiority; never use toy fixtures as quality population

memory.status: bounded wrapper observations available; 100-request/three-model-cycle campaign pending
memory.wrapper: exactly four live allocations per decision: handle, fixed prompt buffer, two (max_prompt_tokens+1)*sizeof(int32_t) buffers; zero after all decisions destroyed
memory.provider: scoped MTLDevice.currentAllocatedSize, never added to process RSS
